# SLS Dock Door Solution with Impinj R700 Boosts Shipping Accuracy


## The SLS D-Series delivers real-time item verification, reducing mis-shipments and improving warehouse efficiency.


### Tackling warehouse accuracy gaps


Warehouses are dynamic environments, with products, pallets, and containers constantly moving in and out. But when shipments are sent to the wrong location or contain missing items, the result is costly delays and disappointed customers. Manual processes, like keying in shipping details by hand or scanning barcodes, are slow, error-prone, and provide limited visibility into what’s moving throughout the facility. Without highly accurate, real-time data, employees lack the insight needed to keep operations on track.


The SLS D-Series dock door solution incorporates[Impinj R700-series RAIN RFID readers](https://www.impinj.com/products/readers/impinj-r700) to verify shipments as they arrive and depart. The result? Exacting reads of items packed in crates and on pallets, reducing mis-shipments and giving warehouse employees insight into what's coming and going with pinpoint accuracy.


---


> The best-in-class R700 performance enables our D-Series dock door solution to deliver industry-leading accuracy and fast event alarming by allowing us to better control the read zone.


---


### Optimized dock door verification with SLS and Impinj


The SLS D-Series shipment verification solution uses the power of RAIN RFID to capture item-level data in real time. As shipments arrive or depart a warehouse, the Impinj readers inside the gates identify the tagged items that pass through. The sensitivity of the R700 series readers allows SLS to maintain low transmit power, minimizes the risk of cross-reads between adjacent read points while still achieving readability objectives for customers.


And when shipped items are affixed with proprietary tags designed by SLS and built on high-performing[Impinj M700](https://www.impinj.com/products/endpoint-ics/impinj-m700-series) and[M800 series endpoint ICs](https://www.impinj.com/products/endpoint-ics/impinj-m800-series) , tag readability is further optimized.


Here’s how the SLS and Impinj solution works:


- SLS D-Series gates with R700 series readers are installed alongside dock doors.
- As crates and pallets of items pass by the gates, the readers capture real-time shipping and receiving data about each RAIN RFID-tagged item inside — even if items are packed tightly and not within direct line of sight.
- Item data is visualized via SLS View software, providing insights into shipping patterns and service-level metrics so warehouse managers can optimize their operations.


“The best-in-class R700 performance enables our D-Series dock door solution to deliver industry-leading accuracy and fast event alarming by allowing us to better control the read zone.” said Matt Smith, SLS Senior Director of Engineering.


### Boost accuracy, cut costs, and simplify setup


Throughout the shipping and receiving process, the SLS and Impinj solution ensures accurate deliveries and shipments, lowers shipping expenses, and improves ROI.


### Accurate order fulfillment


Designed to work in a range of environments with a variety of mounting configurations to provide superior RAIN RFID zone coverage, the SLS D-Series with Impinj R700 readers reduces stray reads, automatically adjusts system performance, and enables accurate tag data delivery. Tags placed on individual items, pallets, or containers are read accurately to ensure that the right goods are on the right truck — driving up to 99% accurate inventory shipping and receiving.


### Confident shipment verification


More accurate item counts mean lower shipping expenses to return mis-shipments and lower shrinkage due to lost goods. And when every item entering and leaving a facility is accounted for, employees can stop worrying about counting and scanning and direct their attention to other more meaningful tasks.


### Efficient inventory management


Exacting inventory counts means employees know exactly what’s on hand. Inventory is optimized to meet customer demand, and costly overstocks are avoided.


### Fast, easy, scalable installation


The D-Series dock door gates leverage a modular design and the experience of SLS technicians, ensuring installation within hours — not months.


### SLS and the Impinj Partner Network


Impinj partner SLS offers RAIN RFID-enabled solutions — from Impinj-based tags and labels to dock door reading gates and data management platforms — to optimize and streamline shipping and receiving for enterprises.
